   - Posterior probabilities:

     - $P(R2|data) = 0.2 / 0.5 = 0.4$
     - $P(R3|data) = 0.05 / 0.5 = 0.1$
     - $P(R4|data) = 0$

   Expected Value (EV) of TRANSFER = $0.84 \times 15 + 0.16 \times 0 = 12.6$ units.
   Since $12.6 > 10$, TRANSFER (INVEST) is the mathematically superior choice.
